text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby got injured,
so I immediately had her treated in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Doctor, thank you very much for treating me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Let us resume our training.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have no time to be
preoccupied with pain of this degree.
choice_data_list: Let's not rush—let's get some rest.
As long as it's within reason...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I cannot accept that.
Please provide valid reasoning as to why rest is necessary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thinking she'd say that, I spread out the latest research paper I had printed out to show her.
choice_data_list: Pushing through the pain won't do you any good.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Then, I shall focus on my treatment.
...Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Let us begin with some light jogging, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When she tried running, her form was off...
Judging from her expression, she likely knows it's the lingering effect of her injury."
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she immediately went on rest, but...
perhaps letting her run a bit was a mistake, as it took
quite a while for her to get back into top shape.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: Looks like there's no problem, huh!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel any pain at all either.
At this rate, I should be able to make a quick return.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby calmly overcame her injury,
making her return remarkably smooth.
